paper.af2_msa_protocol: replace parent TEV query row with each design sequence
paper.m3_fixed_scheme: active site plus top 50% MSA-conserved positions

replication.af2_runtime: task-specific Modal A100 fan-out using ghcr.io/sokrypton/colabfold:1.6.2-cuda12; aws0 is the persistent driver/archive
replication.msa_substitute: current MMseqs TEVd MSA; paper's 2020 UniRef30 HHblits MSA was not released
replication.rationale: Paper specifies query-swapped parent MSA but does not specify supplying 1LVM as an AF2 template. 1LVM is the design backbone and RMSD reference.
replication.ridgey_selection: AF2 gate; every retained helix/sheet mutation has positive WT-structure DDG ensemble mean with at least 4/5 members supporting; loop/coil mutations excluded from stability credit; core-DDG mean-SD >0; fresh own-structure solubility paired-delta mean-SD >0; balanced quality then max-min diversity
replication.ridgey_global_proteolysis_stability_sele: reported only; excluded from gating and ranking
replication.ridgey_secondary_structure_reference: 1LVM PDB chain-A HELIX/SHEET records: 124 structured and 97 loop/coil residues
replication.ridgey_no_c_filter: reject novel C; allow restoration of native TEVd cysteines by DDG reversion
